tagline: ثبت خرید و فروش، به سادگی یک جمله
brief: Android app that replaces the shop's paper ledger: record purchases and sales by voice, barcode or by hand; stock, invoices and reports. For supermarket, grocery and nut-shop owners who are not accountants.
criteria: Distinct from cart/bag/tag/barcode clichés; says 'recorded' at a glance; works at 16 px, in one colour and reversed; fits a warm cream + olive app.

concepts.name: Tally — چوب‌خط
concepts.idea: Four tally strokes — the oldest way to count stock — closed by a check mark instead of a slash: counted and recorded.
rationale: Says the product's promise, 'it's recorded', without drawing a cart or a ledger
The strokes double as goods side by side on a shelf
The wordmark's alefs end in the same round caps as the strokes
True negative-space gutter: works on cream, olive, black and white

recommendation: Tally: approved direction. Master + small-size cut, cream/olive palette, horizontal and stacked lockups.
next_steps: Register the trademark after a professional search
Commission a fully custom wordmark later if desired
